about: What Open WebUI v0.13.3 puts ahead of a chat's first message on a node, as its requests to the gateway send it: the code interpreter on, as the node's model has it in a new chat, and memory on, as the web app has it unless a person turns it off. An owner's and a user's are the same. A chat with the terminal, whose host is named the same in every person's container, is warmed while that API is on. They're warmed in this order, ending with what most chats send. Caught on the bench with patai_docs tools/session-2026-11-14/sniff-gateway.py: catch them again with each release of Open WebUI.
